no_adcom_quote.quote: The Division did not take this NDA to the Psychopharmacological Drugs Advisory Committee.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for LATUDA (lurasidone) NDA200603. The Cross-Discipline Team Leader review states that during the filing meeting the review team determined not to take the application to the Psychopharmacological Drugs Advisory Committee (PDAC) because lurasidone is another atypical antipsychotic with D2/5HT-2 antagonist properties and raised no particular efficacy or safety concern relative to already-approved products in the same class. The medical review's Section 9.3 (Advisory Committee Meeting) likewise states the Division did not take the NDA to the PDAC, so there is no committee record influencing the approval.
